height_convention: H=17 per multiplet before normalized inclination weights E_lm. All degrees use the same total height scale; no photometric degree visibility factor added.
noise: One-sided white PSD B=2 NSR²*3600/1e6. Exponential random ordinates with mean B+sum Lorentzians; independent bins at 0.04 microHz, equivalent 289.35 day uninterrupted series. No granulation background included in these narrow windows.
linewidth_source: Chaplin et al. 1997, MNRAS 288, 623, Table 1; linearly interpolated weighted solar FWHM averages in frequency, not linewidths measured for this model.
rotation: First-order radial GYRE rotation kernel integrated against the area-weighted shell average of GONG 1995–2009 rotation. Core below 0.3 R holds the 0.3 R rate. This shell-averaged approximation omits latitudinal splitting differences; not a full 2D inversion.
